_comment: Domain vocabulary for transcription. 'initial_prompt' primes Whisper toward correct spellings (prevention). 'corrections' are applied to the finished transcript (cure). Keep corrections PHRASE-SCOPED: single common words like 'opioid' or 'England' must never be replaced bare, because they have legitimate uses.

_risky_not_applied._note: Observed mistranscriptions that are NOT auto-corrected because the wrong form is also a legitimate word or the right form is uncertain. Fix these by hand or extend initial_prompt.
_risky_not_applied.England / Ingline: Almost certainly 'Inkling' (the Thinking Machines model), but 'England' appeared legitimately in the same episode (football talk).
_risky_not_applied.Gwen: Likely 'Qwen' (Alibaba model), but Gwen is a real name.
_risky_not_applied.ole / Alex: In the 2026-10-12 In The Loop episode Ejaaz credits 'a friend ole' for a tweet breaking down the solved problems, then later quotes 'Alex' on the quasi-RH result. 'ole' is probably a garbled first name and may or may not be the same person as Alex — unresolved, so the note credits 'a friend' and attributes the quote to the bare 'Alex' with no [[People/...]] link.
_risky_not_applied.WICO / Weco: Startup name uncertain from audio alone; verify against the source before adding.
_risky_not_applied.Mythos / mythos: May be a model codename or the ordinary noun.
_risky_not_applied.Automanus: Heard in a CRM list next to Salesforce and HubSpot. Could be Attio, Monday.com, or a genuine product name — do not guess.
_risky_not_applied.John / Sean: In the @polydao agent-harness clip the speaker self-identifies as 'John' once and is called 'Sean' twice. One of the two is an ASR error; the correct name is unresolved, so quotes are attributed to the opening self-introduction.
_risky_not_applied.Imad / Imai / Emad: Whisper renders Emad Mostaque as 'Imad' (and once 'Imai') throughout Moonshots episodes. Not auto-corrected because Imad and Imai are both real names that could appear legitimately in other shows. Primed via initial_prompt instead; resolve to Emad Mostaque when attributing quotes.
_risky_not_applied.Besson / Besant: Scott Bessent, mistranscribed two ways in the 2026-09-27 Moonshots Live episode. Not auto-corrected because 'Besant' is a real surname (Annie Besant) and 'Besson' a real director. Primed via initial_prompt.
_risky_not_applied.Selim: Another rendering of Salim Ismail, but Selim is a legitimate given name — corrected only in the phrase-scoped 'Saleem Ismail' form.
_risky_not_applied.Epico: In the 2026-09-27 Moonshots Live episode, Dave Blundin says 'the stocks, like including Epico, where I'm the CEO of' — almost certainly EverQuote (he is its chairman), but the audio does not confirm it. Do not guess in a note.
_risky_not_applied.Anderle: Another rendering of Anduril in the 2026-09-28 Palmer Luckey episode (alongside 'Andoril', which IS auto-corrected). Not auto-corrected because Anderle is a real surname. Primed via initial_prompt; fix by hand when it lands inside a quote.

_initial_prompt_caveat: initial_prompt is a single global string currently tuned to the Moonshots/Diamandis show. It mis-primes unrelated content: an AI-agent-architecture clip produced 'LandGraph', 'Pydentic', 'landfuse' and 'clock code' because none of those terms were primed. If non-podcast clips become common, split initial_prompt per show/source rather than growing one list.
